"''I know, I know!|Finn warns Poe Dameron after arriving in the Crystal Chaos of Cardovyte|}} '''Cardovyte''' was an astronomical object in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] that featured the legendary [[Crystal Chaos]], an expanse of [[crystal]]line stalagmites. In [[35 ABY]], during the [[First Order-Resistance War]], the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] in the [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' passed through the Crystal Chaos of Cardovyte while using [[hyperspace skipping]] to escape [[First Order]] [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|pursuing]] them from the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]]. ==Description== The astronomical object Cardovyte was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], situated in grid square M-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. The [[Crystal Chaos]] of Cardovyte consisted of a massive cavernous structure that featured a colossal forest of translucent,''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' sparkling [[crystal]] stalagmites that were capable of destroying [[starship]]s. At least two [[star]]s—one that shone [[Color|yellow]] and another that was red and appeared smaller—were visible in the [[Realspace|space]] near Cardovyte, casting a red glow on the celestial body. One of the stars was bright, its red [[Temperature|heat]] illuminating the stalagmite forest''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' and reflecting light onto the crystal. ==History== {{Quote|What are you doing?''"
"''Lightspeed skipping.|Finn and Poe Dameron, after hyperspace skipping away from Cardovyte|}} By the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War]], the Crystal Chaos of Cardovyte had become legendary and was famous across [[the galaxy]], featuring in [[Hologram|holo]]-adventures. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. while being pursued by [[First Order]] [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] following a [[Resistance]] [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] to [[Sinta Glacier Colony]], the [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] performed [[hyperspace skipping]] in the [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', emerging within the stalagmites of the Crystal Chaos. Fellow Resistance member [[Finn]], who recognized the Crystal Chaos of Cardovyte from holo-adventures, called out to Dameron, who maneuvered the ''Millennium Falcon'' around the stalagmites as the [[TIE series|TIEs]] fired at the [[freighter]], striking several of the columns. Several of the [[TIE series|TIEs]] failed to avoid the stalagmites and were destroyed, and Dameron soon engaged the [[hyperdrive]] once more, arriving at the [[Mirror-Spires]] of [[Ivexia]]. ==Behind the scenes== Cardovyte first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].
